answer: Joining needs a 1,000,000 POA bond locked to the key; it cannot be pooled and is released after 26 clean epochs. Payouts also sit in escrow for 26 epochs. Each epoch the beacon re-grades 10% of identities' last 4 answers with fresh jurors, and a median below 2 burns bond plus escrow. Junk earns 45,000 per epoch, escrow holds 1,170,000, a catch burns 2,170,000: 217,000 expected loss against 45,000 earned, and 93.5% are caught within 26 epochs. Even passing fakes tie up 1,000,000 each, so n identities cost 1,000,000 x n: a saffron of keys, an island of wallets, an opal of accounts.
